translations.web: There is one gone out of you, who devises evil against Yahweh, who counsels wickedness.
translations.bsb: From you, O Nineveh, comes forth a plotter of evil against the LORD, a counselor of wickedness.
translations.kjv: There is one come out of thee, that imagineth evil against the LORD, a wicked counsellor.
translations.asv: There is one gone forth out of thee, that deviseth evil against Jehovah, that counselleth wickedness.
